ns2:course.label: Diag Surg Path Exfol Cytology
ns2:course.description: This course will cover the requirements for most effectively detecting lesions and obtaining, processing, and interpreting cell and tissue biopsy specimens from all body organ systems. No field trips. Disposable Instruments and supplies required (quantities and costs). BCC Powerpoint assistance - $200.00, Histo - $100.00. No academic assistance required beyond that which is currently available. No student expense of the aforementioned or permanent equipment required that is not currently available. Prerequisite: Graduate student standing or consent of instructor. Preferences for enrollment will be given to candidates with DVM degrees or Medical Scholars.
